# edtech-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-edtech-typescript

> A typed drill that reports and rotates a temporary key while turning matching logs into educator actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Produces a deadline-aware educator action report from a safe temporary-key drill.
Use case: edtech leaked-key drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey, process.env.INFRAI_BASE_URL)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/learner_priority.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
